subject: Logic
title: Thinking in Bets
description: A quick, practical guide to Thinking in Bets.

hook.text: A good decision can have a bad outcome. Professional poker players understand this. Most people don't.

buildup.text: Decision quality and outcome quality are separate. You can play the odds perfectly and still lose once.

discovery.text: Annie Duke calls this "thinking in bets"—judging decisions by process, not just results.

twist.text: Resulting—judging a decision by its outcome—punishes good bets that lost and rewards bad ones that won.

climax.text: Over time, good decision-making wins. A single outcome means nothing; the process means everything.

punchline.text: Judge the decision, not the dice.

quiz.question: What is 'resulting'?
options: Judging a decision solely by its outcome
